question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**due to**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence containing the blank, **the reason behind the orange color of the sunsets is discussed.**
 
• Among the given options, the correct alternative to fill the blank is** "due to".**
 
• **"Due to" is used to introduce the reason for something happening.**
 
 
• **Synonyms:** Because of, owing to.
 
• **Example: **The name was omitted from the list due to the employee's oversight.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, **due to the salt particles in the air the sunset appears orange.**
 
• Hence, the **correct answer is option 2) due to**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us understand the usage of other given options:
 
 
• **We use "for" to talk about a person or a reason for something**.

 
 
• These flowers are for Riya.
 
 
 
• **Because is used before giving a reason or explanation**.
 
 
• I can't come to office today, because I am sick.
 
 
 
• **We use as with a noun to refer to the role or purpose of a person or thing**.
 
 
• She has been appointed the new CEO.
